pictures.scene: Frederik de Moucheron, Italiaans landschap met ronde toren - the hill town of pale buildings crowning the wooded height with the great ruined round tower below it and the path climbing the cliff, and the herdsman driving his cattle along the water at the foot of it, a song of ascents of David
pictures.name: pd_moucheron_opgang

pictures.scene: Abraham van Dijck, Der Prophet Elisa weist Naamans Gaben zuruck - Naaman in his plumed turban holding out the gold vessel and Elisha with his hand on his breast and the other raised to refuse it, while the horses and the attendants wait behind, my heart is not proud O LORD, my eyes are not haughty, I do not aspire to great things or matters too lofty for me
pictures.name: pd_dijck_nederig

pictures.scene: Jacob Vrel, Young Woman in an Interior - the bare whitewashed room with its dark beams and its row of pewter plates and the small fire in the great hearth, and the woman sitting sideways on her chair with her chin resting in her hand, perfectly still, surely I have stilled and quieted my soul
pictures.name: pd_vrel_stil

pictures.scene: Sassoferrato, The Virgin and Child Embracing - the child with both arms round his mother's neck and his cheek against her cheek while she holds him close with her eyes lowered, like a weaned child with his mother, like a weaned child is my soul within me
pictures.name: pd_sassoferrato_kind

pictures.scene: Jan Griffier, Riviergezicht - the whole river valley under a wide pale gold sky with the chapel on the wooded height and the castle on its crag, the barges working on the water below and the travellers resting along the stony road, O Israel put your hope in the LORD
pictures.name: pd_griffier_hoop

pictures.scene: Thomas Jones, View of the Campi Flegrei from the Camaldolese Convent near Naples - the two monks standing on the path at the edge of the height with one of them pointing out over the craters and the lake to the sea and the islands at the far horizon, both now and forevermore
pictures.name: pd_jones_eeuwig

lines.text: A song of ascents. Of David.
My heart is not proud, O LORD,
I do not aspire to great things
or matters too lofty for me.
Surely I have stilled and quieted my soul;
like a weaned child with his mother,
like a weaned child is my soul within me.
O Israel, put your hope in the LORD,
